artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact-integer bounded verification of the shifted-gcd-2 classification for all three-prime Lucas-Carmichael triples with smallest prime below 100.
Deterministic output of the bounded verification: 190 three-prime Lucas-Carmichael triples and one shifted-gcd-2 hit.

corrections.note: Clarified the pairwise-coprimality proof by reducing modulo 2d rather than d; this fixes a missing factor of two in the original wording and does not change the theorem.

limitations: The theorem treats exactly three prime factors and only the minimal common shifted-factor gcd. It does not classify higher common gcds or Lucas-Carmichael numbers with four or more prime factors. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; residual risk remains in older or differently indexed elementary literature.
record_title: Uniqueness of the primitive three-prime Lucas-Carmichael number
scientific_context: For a three-prime Lucas-Carmichael number n=pqr, the minimal possible value gcd(p+1,q+1,r+1)=2 occurs if and only if (p,q,r)=(5,13,31), so n=2015 is the unique primitive case.
